predictions.rationale: Primary class that defines the UML State Diagram type; central entry point for creating and managing state diagrams.
Responsible for drawing/rendering elements in a state diagram; directly supports the visual behaviour of state diagrams.
Graph model backing a state diagram; manages the underlying nodes (states) and edges (transitions) used by the diagram.
Figure class that represents individual states within a state diagram; fundamental visual element for the feature.
Figure that depicts transitions between states; essential for showing how an object moves among its possible states.
Specialised figure for sub-machine (nested) states; refines the state diagram feature with advanced state representations.
Handles concurrent regions inside composite states; supports complex behaviour modelling within state diagrams.
Model helper offering utility methods for UML state machines; underpins semantic operations needed by state diagrams.
Generates textual notation for transitions; provides notation support specific to state diagram elements.
Handles textual notation for the body of a state; complements the diagram by rendering state specifications.
